title: Modals: obligation and advice: review
instructionEs: Preguntas mezcladas de toda la unidad.

items.prompt: Children ___ go to school until they are 16.
items.explanationEs: Una obligación con un plural: have to. Must también valdría, pero nunca must to.

items.prompt: You ___ come if you don't want to.
items.explanationEs: Si no quieres, no hace falta: don't have to.

items.statement: I had to take a taxi because there were no buses.
items.explanationEs: Una obligación en el pasado: had to.

items.statement: You mustn't pay: the concert is free.
items.explanationEs: No está prohibido pagar; no hace falta: You don't have to pay.

answers: What should I wear to the interview?
items.explanationEs: Pregunta con should: what + should + sujeto + verbo sin to.

items.text: Last year she ___ (have to) move to another city for work.
items.explanationEs: Obligación en el pasado: had to, igual con todas las personas.

items.sentence: We mustn't buy tickets online: we can pay at the door.
items.explanationEs: No está prohibido comprarlas por internet; no hace falta: don't have to.
